stage0047_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$トライア$$
「Long time no see, Captain $$テッサ$$.」

stage0047_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Thank you for taking the trouble to come,
　Dr. $$トライア$$.」

stage0047_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$トライア$$
「Don't worry about it.
　I wanted to cross-check data with
　this research group here too.」

stage0047_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$トライア$$
「Besides, this is a serious matter.
　It's no time to complain about the hassle.」

stage0047_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$トライア$$
「Unfortunately, it looks like the result will be
　as we guessed. Even as a side effect of the
　boundary stabilizing, it's nothing to laugh at.」

stage0047_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$トライア$$
「The time limit is about 4 months...
　By then the graph will be completely flat.」

stage0047_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$トライア$$
「Even I have my sense of honor.
　That's why my sponsor hears it first, like this.」

stage0047_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Then this information is known only to
　a few of us within $$ミスリル$$
　and your research group, correct?」

stage0047_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$トライア$$
「Well, yes.
　There aren't many people studying
　hyperspace physics in the first place.」

stage0047_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$トライア$$
「But I doubt we can keep hiding this forever.
　More people will start to sense something's off.」

stage0047_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$トライア$$
「Besides, in four months everyone
　will know about it anyway.」

stage0047_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I understand that much.
　I intend to follow the proper steps quickly
　and report it to the Federation $$大統領$$.」

stage0047_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$トライア$$
「Well... even the $$大統領$$
　probably can't do anything about it...」

stage0047_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$テッサ$$
「The $$新世時空震動$$...
　I never imagined it would bring this...」

stage0047_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$トライア$$
「Sorry to interrupt your brooding, but
　how did the investigation I asked for go?」

stage0047_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「As for this thing you call the $$スフィア$$,
　we found no matching data.」

stage0047_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$テッサ$$
「What in the world is this $$スフィア$$...?」

stage0047_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$トライア$$
「That's the thing... I don't know either.」

stage0047_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$トライア$$
「Diverting energy from another dimension
　to obtain enormous output...」

stage0047_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$テッサ$$
「What's known as $$次元力$$, then.」

stage0047_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$トライア$$
「Confirming the phenomenon is one thing, but
　we've only just begun researching how to use it,
　and there's nothing concrete to show yet...」

stage0047_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$トライア$$
「While building that theory,
　a word just popped into my head...
　That's the $$スフィア$$.」

stage0047_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$トライア$$
「I don't quite understand the logic, but
　I think it'll be the key to future research.
　Though nothing but that word comes to mind.」

stage0047_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$テッサ$$
（The way it manifests resembles a $$ウィスパード$$'s...
　Dr. $$トライア$$ never showed any aptitude
　like that before...）

stage0047_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$トライア$$
「Well, never mind...
　If there's no result, just forget about this one.」

stage0047_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$トライア$$
「So, what about the other one?」

stage0047_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I've compiled a report on how
　《$$カルロス$$》 Axion Jr. organized
　《$$新帝国インペリウム$$》.」

stage0047_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$テッサ$$
「If you read this,
　I think you'll understand the details.」

stage0047_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$トライア$$
「As expected of $$ミスリル$$.
　This helps a lot.」

stage0047_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$テッサ$$
「...I hear you and 《$$カルロス$$》 Axion Jr.
　were personally acquainted, Doctor.
　Does this request relate to that?」

stage0047_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$トライア$$
「Well, yes...
　Sometimes between research, looking back,
　his smirking face comes to mind...」

stage0047_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$トライア$$
「And then I stop understanding...
　just what that fool was fighting...」

stage0047_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I understand the $$新帝国インペリウム$$ was founded
　to overthrow the old order, but...」

stage0047_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$トライア$$
「Then Celestial Being or the Black Knights
　would've been enough, I'd think...」

stage0047_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$トライア$$
「What that guy was fighting for...
　If there's a reason behind it, I want to know.」

stage0047_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I don't know if this report
　will help with that, but
　we'll keep investigating regardless.」

stage0047_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$トライア$$
「Sorry about that.
　Even though the world may have bigger problems.」

stage0047_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$テッサ$$
「No...
　Your words gave me something to think about too.」

stage0047_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$テッサ$$
「I'll take my leave now, then.
　If you're going to read the report, Doctor,
　please feel free to use this room.」

stage0047_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$トライア$$
「I'll do that.
　Looks like there's a fair amount to get through.」

stage0047_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$テッサ$$
「As for that matter... the $$エタニティ・フラット$$,
　I intend to act on it swiftly.」

stage0047_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$トライア$$
「Please do.
　Even I find that kind of eternity
　pretty horrifying.」

stage0047_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$トライア$$
「$$エタニティ・フラット$$...
　In a way, it's the end of human history...」

stage0047_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$トライア$$
「That $$スフィア$$ must be the key to a breakthrough.
　Just a baseless hunch, though...」

stage0047_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$トライア$$
「...There it is again...
　Thinking about the $$スフィア$$ gives me a headache...」

stage0047_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$トライア$$
「Because of it, I can't remember...
　someone precious, deep down in my heart...」

stage0047_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Geez, what's this about...
　and on my day off, too...」

stage0047_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$カトル$$
「Calling us in on an emergency basis,
　did something happen?」

stage0047_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$ノイン$$
「To be precise, I want you to prevent
　an incident that's about to happen.」

stage0047_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$ノイン$$
「This mission was requested directly by
　Commander $$レディ・アン$$ of $$プリベンター$$.」

stage0047_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$トロワ$$
「Some sort of VIP protection detail?」

stage0047_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「If so, I'd think $$ゼクス$$ would suit better...」

stage0047_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Unfortunately, I'm not the one for this.」

stage0047_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Don't get it...
　Leaving a job even a guy like you gives up on
　to the rest of us.」

stage0047_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$カトル$$
「$$ノイン$$... what is this mission?」

stage0047_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ノイン$$
「At Jindai High, you'll be guarding
　the $$トゥウィンクルプロジェクト$$.」

stage0047_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$デュオ$$
「So we're guarding $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$...!?」

stage0047_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ヒルデ$$
「No wonder $$ゼクス$$ wanted no part of it...」

stage0047_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ノイン$$
「Operation details will be given on-site.
　But understand, this isn't a game.」

stage0047_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$デュオ$$
（Yeah, right. I smell more chaos coming...）

stage0047_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$カイエン$$
「So you were here.
　Everyone's gathered in the clubroom.」

stage0047_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Cicadas, huh...
　Guess it's that season already.」

stage0047_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Still, they never get tired of singing.」

stage0047_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$シュレード$$
「They spend years underground,
　then sing away their last week, life on the line...」

stage0047_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$かなめ$$
「The Galactic Fairy and the hyperspace
　Cinderella are coming to visit our school!?」

stage0047_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$アルト$$
「I just found out by $$メール$$ myself.」

stage0047_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Whoa!!
　A super popular artist paying us
　an incognito visit on their day off!」

stage0047_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$モロイ$$
「Hm... this gets me fired up...!」

stage0047_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$アルト$$
「This isn't the time to be laid-back!
　There's no way those two, especially $$シェリル$$,
　can stay incognito!」

stage0047_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$アルト$$
「And I was going to eat cold ramen at
　'Niang Niang' on my way home today...!」

stage0047_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$n
「Calm down, $$アルト$$.
　Think about how they just want to enjoy
　their day off too.」

stage0047_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「He said it flat out.」

stage0047_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Would this also be the Grave Pit Drill's doing...?」

stage0047_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$アルト$$
「Damn it...!
　So he's learned to bluff his way through!」

stage0047_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$n
「It's a necessary skill for surviving
　in this Volunteer Club.」

stage0047_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$甲児$$
「Anyway!
　This could throw the whole school into panic!
　Let's figure out a plan!」

stage0047_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$宗介$$
「Shall $n and I set traps
　and capture them?」

stage0047_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Hey, you!
　You want the fans to kill you!?」

stage0047_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$n
「No need to worry, Chidori.
　I'll use a type that keeps things peaceful.」

stage0047_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「How am I supposed to stay calm!
　If this school panics over the $$アルト$$-centered
　Bermuda Triangle, what'll you do!?」

stage0047_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$n
「Most Bermuda Triangle incidents have
　had proper causes identified by recent research,
　so treating them as paranormal is wrong...」

stage0047_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$アルト$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ works out well.
　Let's talk to her about $$シェリル$$ and the others」

stage0047_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$シェリル$$! $$ランカ$$, too!」

stage0047_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Just as promised, I've arrived」

stage0047_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$アルト$$
「I-it's still lunch break!
　You can't just show up now...!」

stage0047_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Oh? $$アルト$$'s school starts summer
　break tomorrow, so there shouldn't be
　any classes this afternoon?」

stage0047_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ランカ$$
「$$正太郎$$ told me about it.
　We email each other sometimes」

stage0047_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$宗介$$
「To think $$ＩＣＰＯ$$ had a spy in it...!」

stage0047_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Now that you mention it, $$正太郎$$
　was a fan of $$ランカ$$'s, wasn't he」

stage0047_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Besides, Takeo General Company sends
　the 'Volunteer Club Newsletter' regularly,
　so we're fully caught up on their school life」

stage0047_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$アマタ$$
「You mean $$ワッ太$$ was a spy, too!?」

stage0047_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$甲児$$
「No way!
　That's got to be $$木下$$'s doing!」

stage0047_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$アルト$$
「That old man!
　Currying favor with $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$!」

stage0047_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$クラン$$
「Still, how did they even make it
　to the Volunteer Club's room...」

stage0047_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Thanks for the guidance.
　You really saved us」

stage0047_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Not at all!
　It's an honor to help you both!」

stage0047_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$風間$$
「Still, that's impressive, Saotome.
　I heard the Volunteer Club even handled
　security for the $$トゥウィンクルプロジェクト$$ concert?」

stage0047_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$アルト$$
「$$小野Ｄ$$, $$風間$$!
　You two... you sold us out!」

stage0047_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$風間$$
「Well, don't blame us,
　almost every boy in school volunteered
　to be their guide...」

stage0047_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「Right, right.
　And since we're in your class,
　we got the honor of guiding them」

stage0047_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$風間$$
「Everyone else just tagged along
　as an entourage, though」

stage0047_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$さやか$$
「Amazing!
　The whole school's boys are crammed
　in the clubroom building!!」

stage0047_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$n
「As expected of the Galactic Fairy and
　the Super Dimension Cinderella...!」

stage0047_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$かなめ$$
「This is no time to be impressed!
　We'll have a panic on our hands!」

stage0047_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't just stand there!
　Hurry up and settle this ruckus!」

stage0047_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$スズネ$$
「That's for you to figure out and
　take responsibility for!」

stage0047_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Onodera, $$風間$$!
　For now, get that unruly mob lined up!」

stage0047_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$竜馬$$
「You're in Class 2-4, aren't you!
　Associate members of the Volunteer Club!」

stage0047_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ランカ$$
「Since we're here, I'd love a tour
　of $$アルト$$'s school」

stage0047_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Naturally, $$アルト$$ will be our guide」

stage0047_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Go right ahead, go right ahead.
　If $$アルト$$ alone isn't enough, we can lend
　you some of our club's proud members」

stage0047_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Leave the secret passages to me」

stage0047_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I can guide you from the sky, too」

stage0047_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Unbelievable...!
　$$アマタ$$, anyone will do for you, huh!」

stage0047_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Sorry, Elements.
　$$アルト$$'s got us covered for now」

stage0047_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$カレン$$
「$$アルト$$!
　The only way to settle this ruckus
　is to offer you up as a sacrifice!」

stage0047_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$アルト$$
「Ngh... can't be helped...!
　Guess I've got no choice!」

stage0047_03:r_f228ae702350849b.text:
$$ランカ$$
「I'm sorry, $$アルト$$...
　You finally got to visit school again,
　and we dragged you around for our own sake...」

stage0047_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$アルト$$
「N-no... that's not what I meant, earlier...」

stage0047_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Quit yammering and get moving!
　Take that crowd with you, too!」

stage0047_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$クラン$$
「Still, trouble's bound to follow
　wherever they go」

stage0047_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「She said it was a chance for
　a treasure photo... and dashed off」

stage0047_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$宗介$$
「...We should have set traps
　and repelled them early on, after all」

stage0047_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Please, don't give me any more
　headaches than I've already got...」

stage0047_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$宗介$$
「That is... as Class 2-4's class rep,
　and as the Volunteer Club's manager,
　you work hard every day」

stage0047_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Oi, Volunteer Club!
　Quit lounging around and go after them!」

stage0047_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$竜馬$$
「They're stirring up trouble
　everywhere they go!」

stage0047_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$竜馬$$
「If you knew, then hurry up, boys!
　Someone could end up dead!!」

stage0047_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$かなめ$$
「W-what do you mean, too bad...」

stage0047_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$宗介$$...
　he looked like he was about to say
　something important, didn't he」

stage0047_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$カレン$$
「I've got to report this to $$テッサ$$...!」

stage0047_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Why does $$ミスリル$$'s pretty young
　captain come into it?」

stage0047_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Could it be... a love triangle...?」

stage0047_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$さやか$$
「That's true...
　In $c, that kind of thing might be
　common, too...」

stage0047_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Come on, $$ＭＩＸ$$.
　No one can stop someone from
　falling for another person...」

stage0047_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$さやか$$
「Speaking of love triangles,
　Kyoko said she saw $n with
　a woman in town the other day」

stage0047_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$さやか$$
「Apparently, that someone...
　was a nurse from that hospital」

stage0047_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$カレン$$
「Eh...!
　Wasn't $n devoted only to
　Miss $$スズネ$$!?」

stage0047_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$さやか$$
「A teacher and a student...
　It really must be difficult, I think」

stage0047_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$カレン$$
「But the way Miss $$スズネ$$ looks at $n
　seems a little special, too...」

stage0047_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$クラン$$
「Looked at that way, romance between
　students has no obstacles at all,
　and is perfectly wholesome」

stage0047_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I-I'll have you know,
　$$宗介$$ and I are not like that at all!」

stage0047_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「But earlier, $$宗介$$...
　seemed a little different than usual」

stage0047_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$かなめ$$
「$$宗介$$!
　You went and did something again, didn't you!?」

stage0047_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$n
「There were explosives planted
　in the school...!」

stage0047_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$カレン$$
「That's not... $$宗介$$'s doing, is it?」

stage0047_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「What about $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$...!?」

stage0047_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$n
「$$アルト$$, $$甲児$$, and $$竜馬$$ are with them...!
　$$ミシェル$$ and $$アマタ$$ are evacuating the boys!」

stage0047_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$かなめ$$
「There are terrorists... in the school...」

stage0047_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「So that's $n's $$ブーストアップ$$...!」

stage0047_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$宗介$$
「This is bad, $n...!
　From the look of it, a good number
　of enemies have gotten into the school...!」

stage0047_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$n
「Is their target $$シェリル$$ and $$ランカ$$...
　or something else...」

stage0047_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$n
「If they start using firearms, we can't fight back.
　$$宗介$$... get Chidori somewhere safe.」

stage0047_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$宗介$$
「Don't worry, Chidori.
　I will protect you, no matter what.」

stage0047_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「This job was to snatch the songstress,
　but maybe I'll grab a little extra too.」

stage0047_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$宗介$$
「I won't hand Chidori over to you!」

stage0047_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Don't get the wrong idea, Kashim!
　It's you I'm here to take!」

stage0047_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「It's not that I missed.
　I chose to miss, just now.」

stage0047_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「It's a rare reunion, after all.
　Let's enjoy it to the fullest, Kashim!」

stage0047_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$宗介$$
「His target is me!
　I don't want to drag Chidori into this!」

stage0047_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「I see...
　So that girl's the reason you changed...」

stage0047_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「That's right, Kashim!
　Though I liked the old you better!」

stage0047_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Oops... did I interrupt a love confession?」

stage0047_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Tch... a party crasher, huh!」

stage0047_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$カトル$$
「Even someone as skilled as you
　can't fight that beast bare-handed.」

stage0047_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「How pathetic, Kashim!
　Hiding behind your friends' backs!」

stage0047_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$ガウルン$$
「Let's start over!
　If you want to protect what's precious to you,
　get in an AS!」

stage0047_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「You... keep going as you are.」

stage0047_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$n
「...You saved us, $$ヒイロ$$.
　Thanks to you all, we somehow managed
　to protect $$シェリル・ノーム$$ and the others.」

stage0047_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$アルト$$
「But what's going on?
　What were those guys planning to do
　after kidnapping $$シェリル$$ and the others...?」

stage0047_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「The war between the Earth Federation and Neo Zeon...
　Within it, their existence carries special meaning.」

stage0047_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Currently, the Frontier fleet
　belongs to the Federation, but being out
　in space, it maintains a neutral stance.」

stage0047_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Being from there themselves, the two of them
　also perform concerts for both the Federation
　and Neo Zeon alike, as neutral figures.」

stage0047_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$カトル$$
「Quite a few people are hoping
　it could spark reconciliation between the two.」

stage0047_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$クラン$$
「That's amazing!
　So those two... could become this world's
　$$リン・ミンメイ$$!」

stage0047_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$カトル$$
「They aren't the only ones like that.
　There are others working in neutral positions,
　hoping for reconciliation between Earth and the colonies.」

stage0047_03:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$デュオ$$
「Word is Princess $$マリナ・イスマイール$$ of Azadistan
　and Representative $$カガリ・ユラ・アスハ$$ of Orb
　are calling for a ceasefire, each in their own way.」

stage0047_03:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$ノイン$$
「Even within the Earth Federation,
　starting with the President and Lady $$リリーナ$$,
　some hold back Earth supremacists, seeking peace.」

stage0047_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
　（$$リリーナ$$...
　So that's the path you chose...）

stage0047_03:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$n
「So that also means there are those
　who see such people as an obstacle...」

stage0047_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$カトル$$
「The mysterious hypnosis-like power
　that triggered the clash between Earth and the colonies...」

stage0047_03:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$カトル$$
「And then there are those who, like today's
　terrorists, target neutral people wishing for a ceasefire...」

stage0047_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$ノイン$$
「$$レディ・アン$$ has asked $c
　to deal with all of that.」

stage0047_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Ahead of the next battle, I hear $c's ships
　will be overhauled at a $$ミスリル$$ facility.」

stage0047_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$n
「To help stop the fighting between
　Earth and the colonies, I hope we can
　learn about the power that started it all...」

stage0047_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$n
「He's helping clean up the school
　with $$甲児$$ and the others, under $$竜馬$$'s direction.」

stage0047_03:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$アルト$$
「How... well, he's brooding as usual...」

stage0047_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$シェリル$$
「...so... what do you see in that broody one?」

stage0047_03:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What do I see in him...
　I've never even thought about that!」

stage0047_03:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$ランカ$$
「So then, you like everything about $$宗介$$?」

stage0047_03:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Look...
　where does that idea even come from...?」

stage0047_03:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Then, let me ask the two of you
　from the $$トゥウィンクルプロジェクト$$ instead.」

stage0047_03:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「What do you see in that wishy-washy
　$$早乙女アルト$$?」

stage0047_03:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$シェリル$$
「Let's see...
　I guess it's that he doesn't treat me special.」

stage0047_03:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$ランカ$$
「Um... well... he always helps me
　whenever I'm in trouble...」

stage0047_03:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$カレン$$
「Lucky guys, both $$アルト$$ and $$宗介$$.」

stage0047_03:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That's why...!
　It's not like that between me and Sousuke!」

stage0047_03:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$さやか$$
「Kyouko said you were on the phone
　talking about something before the battle.」

stage0047_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「That's a blatantly suspicious laugh...」

stage0047_03:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「But it does seem like something good happened.」

stage0047_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$カレン$$
「Just go ahead and tell us what happened.
　We'll help if there's anything we can do.」

stage0047_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$テッサ$$
「$$カレン$$...!
　Isn't taking one side a bit unfair!?」

stage0047_03:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「$$テッサ$$...!
　Why are you here!?」

stage0047_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Didn't you hear from Sagara?
　I've come to pick you up.」

stage0047_03:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Wait... don't tell me... the sea...!?」

stage0047_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes.
　$$千鳥かなめ$$, I invite you aboard our ship...
　the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$.」

stage0047_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What's wrong, Master $$宗介$$?
　You seem even broodier than usual...」

stage0047_03:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This is about that $$ガウルン$$, isn't it?」

stage0047_03:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thought so...
　When you fought that man, Master $$宗介$$'s heart
　wavered, producing 50Z worth of Z-Chips.」

stage0047_03:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll add these Z-Chips to the squad's stock.」

stage0047_03:r_d0fc4899507f74b2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Do be careful, Master $$宗介$$.
　I hear that $$ガウルン$$ is being transferred
　to the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ for questioning.」

stage0047_03:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Personally speaking, I,
　would very much like Master $$宗介$$ to meet that beast
　and produce even more Z-Chips.」

stage0047_03:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$宗介$$
「...I don't take orders from you...」

stage0047_03:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This won't do, this...
　Master $$宗介$$ has ended up
　just like $n...」

stage0047_03:r_e4ae97a37c9b0cce.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I have a feeling there's going to be
　quite the commotion aboard the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$.」

stage0047_03:r_88461d9fd17c56e7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, well...
　Lady $$シェリル$$ and Lady $$ランカ$$, welcome.」

stage0047_03:r_f79b2ac118e41c1a.text:
$$シェリル$$
「So you're $$ＡＧ$$.
　I've heard about you from $$アルト$$ and the others.」

stage0047_03:r_d7bf635b7e5f811c.text:
$$ランカ$$
「So you really are a robot...」

stage0047_03:r_24cb831c779807fd.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「When the two of you look at me like that,
　my internal oil pressure spikes...!」

stage0047_03:r_3f9082480d045564.text:
$$シェリル$$
「That's kind of cute.
　Being able to flatter like that.」

stage0047_03:r_312a78dfbb065f65.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Meeting you like this must be some kind of fate...
　There's a favor I'd like to ask...」

stage0047_03:r_9f17991d2b19374c.text:
$$ランカ$$
「If it's something we can do, we'll help.」

stage0047_03:r_34f8d5cbd504c416.text:
$$シェリル$$
「I don't do this kind of favor for just anyone.」

stage0047_03:r_0a597f4cd9c8309b.text:
$$シェリル$$
「$$ＤＥＭ$$ Corporation, trusted and proven!」

stage0047_03:r_fc7afc4ebf9fd013.text:
$$ランカ$$
「Crossing dimensions to bring
　wonderful goods right to you!」

stage0047_03:r_833975ddd032dd18.text:
$$シェリル$$
「So let's give it our all today too!」

stage0047_03:r_149109e3b1cf253b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you very much!
　I'll be using this commercial again!」
